story.title: Aftermath of an Assassination
story.blurb: Emmett wakes up beside Jess after the crew's payday and tries to apologize for the night before, while Sanya, Garrick and Volentina plot a prank at his expense.

lines.text: The equinox that followed the death of Richard Jamerez was filled with celebration among the Pummelers that partook in it. Emmett, as promised, received the 250,000 ducketts and deposited half of it to the crew's shared account, and distributed the rest to Sanya, Garrick, Vargas, Valentina, and himself. Of course, before that, the crew had a hearty sleep. Sanya went to her room and planted herself, Valentina slept in the janitorial closet, given that she had not been given a room, and Vargas and Theylin crashed in the den. Garrick eavesdropped on Emmett, whose room was trashed from the emergence of The Crave. Emmett was smooshed against his wall as Jess was taking up all of the room on his small, twin-sized bed. The Squoatling, in particular, was shivering from the low temperature, and because of it, he was deeply snuggled into Jess's back. Garrick, despite his perspective on their awkward positioning, felt that Jess was in good hands—er, hooves. The ghost went to the thermostat and heated the ship up for him, making the place feel cozy and warm.

As soon as Emmett woke up, he immediately took his hooves off of Jess and sneezed from the immense amount of Ottori fur in his nose. He stealthily got out of his bed to make sure she did not wake, and he watched her for a little bit, acknowledging his crushed-in closet door and the debris that needed to be cleaned up.
"Damn, last night was a mess,"

segments.speaker: Emmett Tawfeek
segments.text: Damn, last night was a mess

lines.text: Emmett muttered to himself, putting a hoof to his teeth. He realized that he definitely messed up his first impressions with the new Jess. It did not help that the other crew members locked the two of them in his room together, in the dark. Nor did it help that she immediately claimed his bed and slept. Still, however, he technically spooned her without asking, and he quickly clung to her like a tick. Emmett frowned a little. He felt guilty of his actions, especially of his Crave. Was what he did morally wrong? Was it illegal? Emmett pondered this in the quiet of the morning. Jess was of legal age to be an adult according to most customs, but she had the mental capacity of an independent twelve-year-old. She was adult-like in that manner, as she had to make do with whatever she found in Garrick's pockets. At least his conscience told him that he was not a pedophile. Maybe I should apologize. Would that make things weirder? Or would it be the right thing to do? Emmett took out his holodevice and searched on Delivoserv, the galaxy's main source of delivery. If someone ordered a generic item, Delivoserv would deliver it within an hour without any regard to their reputation. They were a completely neutral and inviting company, and Emmett liked that about them.
